title: Win the AI-led holiday while PC demand and costs squeeze us
summary: Counterpoint: Q3 PC shipments fell 21%, Q4 seen down 27%, with record price inflation from memory costs. NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery. Walmart opened to outside AI agents; Google launched Universal Cart; Best Buy joined TikTok Shop.

points.headline: PC demand is falling just as memory costs push prices up
points.detail: Shipments fell 21% in Q3 with Q4 forecast down 27%, while memory shortages drive record PC price inflation. We should plan pricing, promotions and inventory for thin margins.

points.headline: Retailers and Google are setting the rules for AI agents that buy
points.detail: Walmart lets outside AI agents buy with spending controls and agent profiles; Google opened Universal Cart. We should make our store’s product data and checkout agent-ready.

points.headline: AI is now a mainstream way shoppers discover products
points.detail: NIQ finds 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery. Our product content and feeds must work in AI tools, not only in search.

points.headline: Electronics retailers are adding channels for the holiday peak
points.detail: Best Buy joined TikTok Shop for its biggest holiday season, and Adobe forecasts US online holiday sales of $275.1B. We should test our presence on new channels.
